transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
My mind feels foggy all the time—I can’t focus at work or even finish a simple puzzle like I used to. It's really starting to worry me because I need to be sharp for my job.
Have you also been feeling down or losing interest and pleasure in things you usually enjoy? If yes, has that been happening most days for at least two weeks?

Yes, I've been carrying around this heavy, empty sadness lately, and I've completely lost interest in things I used to love, like cooking with my wife or playing guitar with my kid. This has been going on consistently for about three weeks now, pretty much every single day.
How much have these symptoms affected your daily life and ability to work or take care of home responsibilities—would you say they are only a little, or do they make it very difficult?

They are making things very difficult for me. My supervisor has already pulled me aside twice for missing things on the security monitors at work, and at home, my wife is really upset because I just sit there and don't engage with her or our kid.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I don't have any plan to hurt myself, but when I'm driving home after a long shift, I catch myself thinking it wouldn't really matter if I didn't wake up. I just sometimes feel like everyone might be better off without me messing things up.
Have you noticed feeling physically slowed down or agitated, or having trouble getting out of bed, showering, or taking care of yourself most days?

My body constantly feels like it's moving through mud, and walking my rounds at the casino is much slower than usual. I'm still managing basic self-care like showering, but even getting up from my chair takes an extra push because everything feels incredibly heavy. I definitely feel slowed down rather than agitated.
Have you lost a lot of weight or had a major change in appetite, or has your sleep been severely disrupted most nights?

Most days I'm just not hungry, so I end up skipping meals at work or just picking at my food, and my wife noticed my uniform is fitting looser lately. My sleep hasn't really been a major or severely disrupted issue for me, though.
